settings.subtitle: ABOUT US
settings.title: Designed for Care. Made for Comfort.
settings.text: We create premium medical scrubs designed to support healthcare professionals through long shifts, busy days, and everything in between.

settings.subtitle: OUR STORY
settings.title: Built Around the People Who Care for Others
settings.text:
Healthcare professionals spend long hours caring for others. We believe their workwear should be designed with the same level of care.

Our journey began with a simple idea: create scrubs that combine comfort, functionality, quality, and modern style. Every detail — from the fabric we select to the fit and finishing — is considered with everyday healthcare professionals in mind.

settings.subtitle: OUR FABRIC PHILOSOPHY
settings.title: Why We Choose Premium Cotton
settings.text:
We believe the fabric you wear for 8-12 hours matters. That's why we focus on premium cotton and carefully selected materials that offer a soft, breathable, and comfortable experience throughout the day.

Our goal is simple: make workwear that feels good, performs reliably, and looks professional.

settings.subtitle: OUR VALUES
settings.title: What Makes Us Different.
settings.text: Thoughtfully designed. Carefully made. Always for you.
settings.val_text_1: Soft, breathable fabrics designed for long hours of wear.
settings.val_text_2: Practical details and thoughtful features made for busy professionals.
settings.val_text_3: Professional silhouettes with a clean, contemporary look.
settings.val_text_4: We focus on fabric, construction, fit, and finishing at every stage.

settings.subtitle: MADE FOR YOU
settings.title: Made for Long Shifts. Designed for Real Work.
settings.text: From early morning rounds to late-night shifts, our scrubs are designed to move with you. We focus on comfort, functionality, durability, and a professional appearance — so you can focus on what matters most: caring for your patients.

settings.subtitle: OUR COMMITMENT
settings.title: Our Promise to You
settings.text: We are committed to continuously improving our fabrics, designs, and craftsmanship to create workwear that healthcare professionals can rely on every day.

settings.title: Care for People. Care for a Better Tomorrow.
settings.text: Better workwear for brighter days — for you, for your patients, and for a healthier tomorrow.
